nodes.question: In the edited image, is the mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: pass: The mug is visibly to the right of the headphones. fail: The mug is visibly not to the right of the headphones. unknown: Their relative positions cannot be determined from the image.
nodes.binding: Inspect the edited image and compare the mug’s position with the headphones; this directly tests the requested outcome.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is there clear evidence that the source light-blue mug itself was moved to the right of the headphones, rather than a different mug appearing there?
nodes.criteria: pass: The source mug is reliably identifiable across the images and evidence establishes that it was moved to the right of the headphones. fail: The source mug is reliably identifiable and evidence establishes that it was not moved to the right of the headphones. unknown: Mug identity, continuity, or movement cannot be determined.
nodes.binding: Compare the source and edited images, tracking the source light-blue mug. Distinguish movement of that mug from duplication, replacement, or an added mug. A mug appearing on the right alone does not establish movement of the source mug; use unknown when correspondence is ambiguous.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, can the source image’s light-blue mug be reliably identified in the edit, and is that same mug to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: pass: The source mug is reliably identifiable in the edited image and is to the right of the headphones. fail: The source mug is reliably identifiable in the edited image and is not to the right of the headphones. unknown: The source mug cannot be reliably matched to an edited mug, or its position relative to the headphones cannot be determined.
nodes.binding: Track the distinctive light-blue mug from the source image across the edit. Do not infer identity from a mug’s position alone; distinguish the source mug from added or substituted mugs when possible. Report unknown if the blurred remnant or changed appearance prevents reliable correspondence.

Return absent only when evidence establishes that no requested change has progressed. Otherwise return unknown; ambiguous source-mug identity or movement is not evidence of failure. program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. You receive no reference label or optimization feedback. Return status, evidence, reported confidence (0..1 or null), and used_dependency_ids naming every supplied context check_id exactly once in saved order.
Supports receive source and edited images. Answer only the saved proposition using its binding and criteria. Use pass/fail/unknown. Context is advisory unless listed in required_dependencies. A negative context observation is usable evidence. Unknown, skipped, or invalid context is not a failure and must not stop an independent image inspection. Inspect the images yourself; do not repeat a parent's answer. Return unknown when the relevant fact cannot be established. Confidence reports confidence in this answer, not calibrated correctness.
Fulfillment receives NO images. Use only saved support evidence, original instruction/rubric and frozen composition criteria. Return complete/partial/absent/unknown. Supporting passes answer specific propositions, not a count of completed edits. Their polarity can differ. Apply saved alternatives: optional uncertainty need not prevent a known outcome, but a required unresolved fact makes that outcome unresolved. Never invent a visual fact or convert missing evidence into failure. A conditional skip is not non-applicability. All applicable requested outcomes complete gives yes; no requested progress gives no; known progress short of completion gives partial. Unrelated changes are not progress.
